title: 后室 最终归宿 Demo
description: This is an action-adventure horror game with the theme of back rooms. You will be trapped in a strange, endless back room, have to evade unknown, terrible creatures, explore hidden clues, solve environmental puzzles, and find the only escape route.

title: CrazyVolleyball Demo
description: A first-person volleyball game built around physical ball contact and teamwork. Receive, set, spike and block in online 2v2, 3v3 and 6v6 matches, or practice in solo matches and training. Position yourself, time your swing and keep the rally alive.

title: Adventure Seekers: Restless Waters Collector's Edition Demo
description: A giant whale is terrorizing a tropical port, and its attacks are anything but random. Explore Santa Marilla, question frightened locals, and begin the investigation in the demo of Adventure Seekers: Restless Waters Collector's Edition.

title: KINGDOM ROAD Demo
description: You fall asleep after work with your bugs unfixed, and wake up inside your own game. This free demo covers the first three castles: build a deck from your Summon Cards, merge towers, and summon heroes to turn real-time battles around.

title: Idle Ascent Demo
description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

title: DNOWHERE Demo
description: Dive into an atmospheric 3D puzzle-platformer set in an industrial nightmare. As a weaponless boy, sneak through the colossal, rusted city of DNO to rescue Princess Aya—the last flicker of light. Outsmart mechanical watchers, evade grotesque enforcers, and survive a cinematic journey.

title: Endless Summer Syndrome Demo
description: You ended the world. She, the one who holds every card, gave you an endless summer as your reward. Now your only way out is through sugar, jellyfish, sunlight, and blood — into the deepest reaches of her mind, or be dissolved along the way. Choose your path in this psycho-thriller visual novel.

title: 影灯りの怪盗 ― 光と影のパズル Demo
AFK Throne Demo
description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them.

title: AIONOIA Demo
description: AIONOIA is a minimalist incremental idler about an ancient machine built to spark existence itself. Generate Potential and experiment with powerful modifiers to transform simple circuits into increasingly absurd chain reactions.

title: Goblin Must Clean Demo
description: A free demo of Goblin Must Clean, an incremental cleaning game in first person. Its own pile of 25,000 dirty plates, Scrub for Gold.

title: 迷雾游戏编辑器 Demo
description: No coding? No problem. Mist Game Editor is a drag-and-drop tool for visual novels and mystery puzzle games. Drop in your script and images, auto-generate a playable demo, then tweak story branches, UI, and puzzles at your own pace. Multi-language support and one-click export to PC, mobile, and web

title: The Doll Museum Demo
description: This 2D psychological horror game traps you in a pastel-pink doll museum, where you help Valentine to survive the cruel Doll Queen!

title: Ember and Ash: The Cradle Demo
description: Play the full first act of Ember and Ash: The Cradle — voiced story, hands-on turn-based combat and your first night at camp. Your save carries over to the full game.

title: Tinycube Tales Demo
description: Play the first world of Tinycube Tales for free!Climb Mount Billygoat, a full world of 10 levels packed with panicking chickens, bouncing bunnies and stubborn goats… all the way to the Giant Goat boss fight!

title: Bakery Simulator Online Demo
description: Open your own bakery and manage every part of the working day. Prepare dough, bake a variety of goods, stock your displays and serve customers. Play Bakery Simulator solo or team up with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Slimetopia Demo
description: Click, build, craft, and defend! Lead a colony of cute slimes in this cozy city-builder clicker. Arm your slimes with munitions to stop the Overlord's thief goblins from plundering your vaults!

title: Mountain Home Demo
description: Mountain Home is a 2D adventure about a monk who has forgotten who he is and is forced to journey through cursed lands, interact with forest spirits, battle malevolent demons, help sorrow filled ghosts to ultimately uncover the secret of his past.

title: Wishing Well Demo
description: The free demo of Wishing Well, a cozy first-person cleanup game: wake the grumpy old well, clean up the forest, make your first wishes, break the fallen log and meet the goose. Stay and clean the forest to 100%. The pond, the mine and the village wait in the full game.

title: VOrbit ASMR Demo
description: Try VTuber binaural audio with your usual microphone. Move your voice with VTube Studio, nizima LIVE or VMC tracking, or use manual positioning. Explore HRTF profiles and room acoustics. Demo: spatialization is bypassed for 5 seconds every 30 seconds; microphone audio continues.

title: Tiki Bar Demo
description: Run a small tropical bar by night, mix cocktails, and serve customers. But keep your eyes open... something feels wrong about this place.

title: Drones vs Tanks Demo
description: Try both sides of a first-person FPV drone vs. tank duel. Learn the controls against AI or challenge a friend online, then switch vehicles between rounds.

title: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together Demo
description: Try a cozy first-person sorting game, alone or with up to three friends. Put 100 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes, dress the mannequins and see the theatre begin to light up.

title: Nectarbound Demo
description: A short, active incremental game about a bee with a vacuum. Collect nectar, turn it into coins, and buy upgrades. Hire ladybugs to plant flowers and worker bees to carry your haul. Day brings flowers. Night brings trouble.

title: Through the Varnish Demo
description: Step through the varnish and into Van Gogh's The Starry Night. Explore a museum after closing time, talk to the people inside the painting, find hidden objects, and learn the stories behind the art. Free demo of Through the Varnish.

title: For What Remains Demo
description: For What Remains is a top-down twin-stick shooter incremental. Fight through hordes of zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your weapons and equipment. Grow stronger with every run, and do whatever it takes to survive the infection.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV – Painter Demo
description: Paint your army and prepare for war with the free Dawn of War IV Painter Demo. Customise entire armies or individual units with detailed colours, materials and decals. Save your creations, share them with friends and import them into the full game.

title: Goblins' Healer Demo
description: Become the healer of a chaotic goblin crew in this single-player VR fantasy adventure. Heal, support and command your unruly team as you venture through deadly dungeons to find your way home.

title: An Immortal's Journey Demo
description: Play Xiao Mao’s opening story at the Azure Cloud Sect through Qi Refinement III. Choose one of five cultivation scriptures, take sect commissions, craft your first supplies, and put your training to the test in turn-based battles.

title: Crystal Cascade Demo
description: Try the first 20 levels of Crystal Cascade free. Match colourful gems, build combos and collect gold in Arizona, including bonus rounds. Replay the demo at your own pace, then continue your adventure by purchasing the full game.

title: Lyra Side Demo
description: 《Lyra Side 晚星：侧影》 She lives on the other side of your desktop, keeping you company as you read, play music, or simply daydream, from morning light to starry nights. Sometimes, the most beautiful stories begin with simply being there for each other.

title: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator Demo
description: Pull the overgrown Backyard clean blade by blade, sell your harvest and upgrade your tools in this free demo of a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

title: Planet Sim Demo
description: Planet Sim is a factory and colony builder set on a procedurally generated planet. Land with a rover and a lander, build your first colony, and try two short previews of the late game. Play the demo without a time limit.

title: 雨蛙天 Demo
developer: 汉谟拉比炒面, 我的屁是香哒

title: The Last Inn Demo
description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

title: Americana: The Dead Years Demo
description: Survive five in-game days in a first-person sandbox set in 1980s America. Fight zombies and hostile survivors, tear through a fully destructible world, build homes and repair bridges in a county that keeps changing without you.

title: Sacrificium Demo
description: Turn-based roguelike. Every creature carries a trait you can only claim by sacrificing it at the altar. Stack traits into a build, watch your team shrink, and reach the final fight with nothing left to spend. Power is always subtraction.

title: Defeat the Boss Demo
description: In this incremental game, you fling peasants at giant bosses for fun! Yeet animals for meat, feed your peasants until they become gloriously chonky, unlock new units with gold, and build a ridiculous army capable of smashing even bigger bosses.

title: ONE BRAINCELL Demo
description: Two bodies. One brain. Zero common sense. ONE BRAINCELL is a 2-player online co-op puzzle platformer where only one of you can think at a time. Pass the brain, steal it at the worst moment, yell secret codes across the room and fail gloriously together.

title: Blocknic Demo
description: Try BLOCKNIC for free with 24 handcrafted levels. Slide blocks, match colors, and use gravity and moving platforms to solve clever puzzles.

title: DRONES Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the enemy's deck, not your own. In this physics-based auto battler, you choose which monsters invade and discard the ones you can't counter. Buy, equip, and position autonomous drones, then watch them fight. Find the synergies that save the solar system.

title: Liar’s Dice: Queens of Sin Demo
Unwilling Executioner Demo
description: A sadistic killer is forcing you to choose who lives and dies. Investigate and find clues scattered around The Bunker to save your family. Double check every detail before time runs out, because one wrong pick and you’ve killed someone you love.

title: Hawker Demo
description: HAWKER is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

title: In The Vroms In Clones Demo
description: A police officer finds himself trapped in a strange cycle upon arriving at the station. Rooms, conversations, and events repeat endlessly. Whenever he walks through a door, he returns to the same spot.

title: Ferazel's Wand Demo
description: Play the original 3-level demo of the cult classic fantasy platformer, rebuilt for modern macOS, Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck systems.

title: The Peasants Are Coming! Demo
description: You are the nobility and tens of thousands of furious peasants pour down the roads at your granary, treasury and castle. Hire the guard, raise a circus to distract, even toss them! Anything to break their leaders before they reach your throne.

title: 东方铭珠塔 Demo
description: 本试用版包含了游戏的基本游玩逻辑展示，以及游戏内是如何进行讲述故事的。包含3个关卡，2个对话展示。

title: Gunfetti Demo
description: Pick a hero and jump into fast pixel-art shootouts against bots. This demo is single-player only; online multiplayer and ranked matches are in the full game.

title: Kaiju Tactic Demo
description: Kaiju Tactic is a Real-Time Tactics + Roguelike Monster strategy game! Mutate, Modify, and Evolve your monsters! Command your strongest monster squad through Roguelike stages!

title: めっちゃジャンケン Demo
description: Lose at rock-paper-scissors. Win with your fists! Battle through a garden, a convenience store and a nightclub with ridiculous weapons and Eringi power-ups. Play solo against NPCs, with 2–4 friends using a room code, or in 1v1 Quick Play.

title: TAYAMNICA Demo
description: Tayamnica is a third-person puzzle game featuring world exploration. This calm, atmospheric game—free of time limits—transports you to another world where Amelia has ended up after failing to notice a portal that suddenly appeared before her. Help Amelia find her way back to her own reality.

title: Quest for the Golden Nail Demo
Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator Demo
description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

title: 林西物语 —— 放置武侠村 Demo
description: An enormous narrative idle game with tons of systems: farming, logging, fishing, cultivation, reincarnation, recruiting heroes, building a town, armies and conquering nations to unify the continent. Plus 300,000+ words of story, a full world, yuri romance and a visual novel to read while idling.

title: Tidy Up The Christmas Shop Demo
description: Tidy up a cozy Christmas shop solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op! Find, carry and sort thousands of festive objects across 765 item types. Upgrade your gift sack, unlock a little Christmas magic, and bring order to the holiday chaos, one shelf at a time.

title: Drain It All Demo
description: Drain a 10,000-ton dam, starting with a paper cup. Sell water, buy pumps, build a filtering and bottling plant, and find out what is at the bottom of the dam. A first-person incremental game about one extremely bad plan.

title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business Demo
description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive. Experience the first 4 days and get a glimpse of the chaos waiting ahead.

title: Out A Space Demo
description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship in this 4-sector playable demo

title: 霞客行 Cloudfarer Demo
description: Bring a wuxia party to your desktop. Let them travel and earn loot while you build decks, choose routes, and face bosses in turn-based battles. The demo covers Normal stages 1-1 through 3-4, including Hunts and character tutorials.

title: Barely Developers Demo
description: Start a game studio in your mom's garage in this first-person tycoon. Make and publish games, decorate your office, hire unpredictable employees, and grow from broke indie developer to AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends—just don't let Mom pull the plug.

title: 10 Million Cubes Demo
description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

title: Topple Demo
description: Try TOPPLE free! Line up your dominoes and push. Every tile that topples hits the enemies beside it, and long chains multiply the damage. Hold back enemies from the right, clear all of Act 1 and topple its boss. Frozen and collapsing boards, more characters and rare tiles are coming soon.

title: Quack Hunters Demo
description: A 1-4 player physics-based hunting simulator. Aliens abducted your grandpa’s beloved goat and irradiated everything else in the forest. To bring this goat home, you’ll have to pick a gun and become a true Quack Hunter.

title: スクラップ・スロット・アリーナ Demo
DOODLE ISLES Demo
description: Everything you draw comes to life. Draw soldiers, walls, cannons and ships, build your castle on your island, then set sail and raid your rivals with up to 4 players. Can't draw? Your wobbly army will still fight. Probably.

title: The Red Button Problem Demo
description: The Moderator has reserved the Personality wing for you. Explore a first-person test facility, inspect its machinery, and decide which buttons to press and which instructions to ignore. The facility will record your choices.

title: Unboxed: Idle Case Tycoon Demo
description: Open cases, collect rare weapon skins, and build a fully automated skin business. Upgrade your auto-openers, fill your Vault, and outbid the bots in the Auction House. One more case. Always one more.

title: Carta Bellum Demo
description: Binding of Isaac meets Slay the Spire. A turn-based roguelike RPG about a wizard with no self-control. Find treasures that change your magic, and outsmart monsters and adventurers in a cozy world full of charming creatures. Careful though... kill a friendly adventurer and they all come after you.

title: Writelings Demo
description: Try Writelings free with the Night Owl. A small illustrated writer sits in the corner of your screen and works on a book of their own, but only while you type. Longer books and more writers are in the full game, and your demo progress carries over.

title: Xiangqi: The Art of War Demo
description: Play the first three battles of the Chu–Han War, three tournament rounds, four lessons and 20 stratagems free, with Sun Tzu as your teacher. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Gold Below Demo
description: The free demo of Gold Below, a pixel-art loot roguelike: the whole first depth, floors 1 to 10. Buy and merge gear, stack a set, and beat the Tallyman at the bottom.

title: Gnomenclature Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where cards must be played together, and order matters. Collect, upgrade, and unleash powerful combos on a variety of whimsical garden creatures.

title: Market Fit Demo
description: Pull the strings to decide what trends, push prices up and alter the turn order to sell at the highest margin. Run production and sales in this minimalist turn-based economic strategy game, and never forget the board is watching. Don't predict the market, manipulate it.

title: Startelf - Der Fußballmanager Demo
description: Player's Eleven - Football Manager is a football management game in which you take over clubs with very different identities – from world club to talent factory to traditional club. It's up to you to write the next chapter of their story.

title: Couch Potato Demo
description: Meet Tiny Spud, a little potato who lives on your desktop. Watch him binge TV beside your work, cook disasters, play his retro console and wander onto your taskbar. The demo has the first week of his story, two days out and no time limit. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: The Night Shift Demo
description: Play the first three nights of The Night Shift. As the lone night watchman you watch the cameras, lock the doors and survive whatever the dark sends. A short horror demo cut straight from the full released game.

title: Case Unknown: The Complete Files Demo
Runemoor Demo
description: Runemoor demo: 10v10 PvP capture the flag. Every champion is unlocked: steal the enemy Rune Banner and carry it home in fast-paced team battles where any fight can turn in seconds. Play full matches online before launch.

title: We Will Die For You Demo
description: Destroy & defeat disease in an incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Fight disease, earn Protein, die, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

title: Zotenhold Demo
description: Try Zotenhold for free. Pick the Knight, Cleric, Warrior, Mage or Ranger and hold the castle through the first ten waves, alone or in online co-op with friends who have the demo. Your Renown and account progress stay on this PC when you buy the full game.

title: Breeder Protocol Demo
description: Play the first three drops of Breeder Protocol. Drop into a living alien hive alone or with up to three friends, rescue the stranded crew, level up mid-run and fight your way down to the Brood Mother. Includes Campaign, Swarm and co-op with five operators.

title: Quiero un mate Demo
description: Quiero un mate is a psychological horror game set in an old Buenos Aires apartment building. You wake up in an unfamiliar kitchen with a single task: make a mate without letting the water boil. Solve puzzles, explore the building floor by floor and try to escape.

title: Three Kingdoms: Command the Warlords Demo
Friendly Football Demo
description: A football party-game? A co-op career mode game? Both. Check what this game is all about in this demo!

title: Get Your Cards in a Row Demo
description: Your uncle Jeff left you his game shop, and it's been ransacked. Put over 25,000 things back where they belong in this first-person physics sim. Dig through the heaps, unlock rooms, upgrade your tools, and tidy up alone or with up to 3 friends.

title: Carbon Conservatory Demo
description: The first level of a botanical bullet hell Souls-like. Parry spore-fire back into the overgrowth, seed it until it splits, and make it bloom. Cross the Conservatory, face the Allocation Engine, and hunt the two bosses who guard what it hides.

title: Final Rider Demo
description: A 40-min demo of FINAL RIDER. Life is expensive. A mad TV show offers $300 to die. Dive into neon streets, brutal shootouts & 90s anime arcade mayhem. The world's lost it—have fun!

title: Forge Defense – Die Runenschmiede Demo
description: Tower defense with a forge behind every shot. The free demo opens the Frostcrown Mountains: ten levels on the Ancestral Road, where you mine ore, forge ammunition in your dwarven hall and send it through the rune gate against the orcs.

title: Re:act Demo
description: Every stone, every pane of ice, every turn lands on the beat, so the music tells you what’s coming. Crash, rewind, try again, until it clicks and you know it by heart. Every mode is a different way to answer the music. No note highway. The level is the song.

title: Incremental POP: Fishing Demo
description: Free demo: fish in quick rounds, spend your gold on upgrades and fuse your tools. Play the first 2 rings of the Fishing Reef, from the creek to the pier, and see how one hoop net becomes an ocean-wide haul in the full game.

title: Plastic Battle Rush Demo
description: Battle as plastic army men in this high stakes team FPS. Steal plastic from rivals and haul it to your tubes to bank the win. But beware: the more you carry, the slower you move. One shot, one kill. High speed rounds. Toy themed chaos.

title: Wacky Hunters Demo
description: A chaotic co-op hunting adventure for 1–4 players. Explore a sprawling mountain valley, hunt unpredictable wildlife, restore the balance of nature, and face legendary beasts. Just don't expect the animals to play fair.

title: Did a Monkey Write This? Demo
Gildagoetia Demo
description: Lead Alma and his companions across a continent torn by war in this free tactical RPG demo. Play through Chapter 9 of Alma's story, command allies in turn-based grid battles, combine their strengths, and enjoy illustrated combat and support conversations.

title: Tap Tap Fish: Abyssrium Desktop Demo
Tinyfab Demo
description: A demo of the early part of Tinyfab with no time limit. Mine ore, move it on belts, smelt it, assemble parts and research new machines. The CO2 from your factory wakes the zombie graveyards nearby, so you will need defenses too.

title: Put Out The Sun Demo
description: The free first stretch of Put Out The Sun, a co-op incremental game about extinguishing a star. Land on the Sun as four-armed aliens, spit and spray it dark, mine ice and upgrade from Spit to the Backpack Pump. Online co-op for 1-6 players. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Asteroid Onslaught: Command. Defend. Survive - Demo
description: A wave defense where your drones fight on their own and you command as much or as little as you like. Mine what they shatter, draft upgrades between waves, and hold the line against an onslaught of asteroids.

title: 财富大爆炸 Demo
description: Wealth Explosion is an idle game with endless growth, divine trials, and deckbuilding. Rise from a shack to become the universe's richest being and the God of Reincarnation. Collect artifacts, challenge gods, explore adventures, and build decks. For fans of idle games and roguelites.

title: I'll Pay You Next Week Demo
description: Take over your uncle's wholesale business and supply the neighborhood for up to five in-game years. Compare quotes, watch expiry dates and decide who gets credit. A shop may offer more for your last case of soy sauce, but can you afford to wait until next week to get paid?

title: Saltwind: Idle Island Tycoon Demo
description: Try the first three islands of Saltwind for free: build a cozy hex-grid trade empire, link production chains, fill contracts and set sail on your first voyage. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

title: fogpost Demo
description: Play the first 20 Fogpost puzzles for free. Guide a delayed echo, time your moves around the tide, and light both beacons on the same turn. Replay for gold stamps and carry your demo records into the full game on the same computer.

title: ZhaoYou: Yin-Yang Crossing Demo
description: A co-op tower defense game with auto-battler team building. Recruit heroes, combine synergies and forge equipment under relentless waves. Try the Lost Church on difficulty 1 or 2, solo or with up to four friends. Replay freely and explore different builds.

title: Redline Rookie: A 4WD Racing Career Demo
description: Round 1 of the full game, free. Swap motors, gears, tires and rollers in the garage, run a practice lap to read the data, then set your car on Rookie Loop against nine rivals over 5 laps. You can’t touch the car once it’s running. Your save carries into the full game.

title: Imperialist Demo
description: From a veteran 4X developer comes a game of logistics, trade and empire. Lead one of seven European powers from 1500 to 1950: explore the New World, ship its wealth home, industrialise your Capital, and hold an empire that wants to break free. Can you exploit the New World to control the Old?

title: Desktop Divinity Demo
description: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

title: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler Demo
description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

title: Tech Legends Simulator Demo
description: Open a tiny PC shop and make it the talk of Northgate. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, set your prices, ring up customers at a real register, and build your first gaming PC's by hand. Play your opening three days, then carry your shop into the full game.

title: Nightbound Ledger Demo
description: Chinese folk horror × idle turn-based. Lead mercenaries through ten eerie regions in Nightbound: recruit from the roster, assign skills, farm affix gear, then watch auto-battles unfold line by line in the combat log. Gear sets your ceiling; formation decides how the fight plays out.

title: Magitech Mecha: Requiem of the Azure Flame Demo
description: A philosophical, character-driven sci-fi adventure blending visual novel storytelling, dungeon exploration, and turn-based combat. Play as Adrian, a legendary mercenary. Pilot a Mana Mecha into uncharted Rifts, meet people on other paths, and witness civilizations collide as the old order falls...

title: Penknife Demo
description: he closer to death you are the stronger you become, Penknife is a Survival Horror where a British chav accidentally unleashes an eldritch invasion. Fight to survive with limited resources within an open, interconnected world, infested with horrifying monsters.

title: Corehold Demo
description: Corehold is a dungeon defence strategy game. Carve corridors, rotate and fit buildings into tight rooms, recruit defenders and set traps for invading heroes. Your army shapes your faction's future, while your Dungeon Boss protects the Core.

title: Moments Demo
description: Moments is a point to go adventure game where you can explore the land with two besties, Mai and Shiro. There are tasks and puzzles that help Mai with solving her way through the adventure. She captures the cute creatures, Hibimon, which helps unlock important mysteries in the diary.

title: 异化之境 Demo
description: Free demo. Explore a strange world after nuclear war, solo or in online co-op. With shoulder-mounted robot Chen Xiaola, gather resources, build a base, and assemble and pilot your own machines. Brave the wilds and war ruins to uncover the secrets of a unique energy source.

title: R-01: A Space Survival Adventure Demo
description: R-01 is a space survival adventure game. You'll have to find and drill minerals from the asteroid belt, use them to build structures, and fight off creatures that don't want you there. Your ultimate goal: build a rocket and fly home.

title: Super Ninja Miner Demo
description: The demo includes 10 levels and a battle against a fierce underwater boss, as well as a couple of hidden secrets.

title: I Herd Ewe Demo
description: It's time for the sheep to head home! Will you command your team of dogs to round them up in as few turns as possible? Or will the sheep outsmart you with their wooly ways? Make use of each dog's unique ability to get the sheep home as efficiently as possible in this wholesome tactical puzzle game.

title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense Demo
description: Build a maze. Send an army. Win as a team. Try Rampartloom’s free 3v3 tower defense demo with no time or match limit. Draft a faction, grow your income through attacks, and coordinate assaults to break the enemy’s defenses.

title: Moonlit Vigil Demo
description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

title: No Place in the City Demo
description: No Place in the City is an urban life simulation game where you start with almost nothing. Find work, earn a living, rent a place to stay, take care of yourself, and slowly find your footing in an unfamiliar city.

title: Lonely Braves Demo
description: The free demo of Lonely Braves. Centuries ago, Academy, Church and Knights sealed the Demon Clan in another dimension. As generations passed, the ancient seal weakened, unleashing monsters once more. The new-generation factions dispatched their marginal figures to address crises symptomatically.
developer: Beijing Mayfly & Grain Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Midnight Kino Demo
description: A zombie nightmare in an empty cinema. Survive wave after wave of the dead, spin the Midnight Roulette to rewrite the rules every three waves, and take on the midnight screening alone or with a friend.

title: GunJong Demo
description: This demo doesn't support VR yet but full version of game will

title: ION: COREBREAK Demo
description: Pilot a combat mech in this solo survival shooter. Aim BASTION’s Gatling, dash through swarms and upgrade your weapons as you fight. Hold Solargraben for 15 minutes, face KILN-9 and earn VECTOR for future runs.

title: Arctic Station Six Demo
description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs and wire components together to report atmospheric conditions, warn of gales, and control an ice-borne rover. The demo plays the first seven years. Your progress will carry over.

title: Hyper Gravity Demo
description: A physics-based platforming challenge where you harness gravity to roll, bounce, dribble a gravity ball through 8 handcrafted challenges. Master your momentum, find your flow, and get the ball in the goal!

title: Doomigos Demo
description: Survive 10 waves in the Doomigos single-player demo. Choose your character, build your arsenal, collect upgrades, and face a randomly selected final boss.

title: Doodle Wars: Ink and Paper Demo
Pixel Platoons Demo
description: **Play the free demo!** Command your squad in retro-inspired, top-down military action where every soldier matters and every loss is permanent. Fight, survive, earn promotions and build your platoon. Classic 16-bit action meets persistent progression and lasting consequences.

title: SUPER FIGHTERS -LEGENDS- [DEMO]
description: Pick your favourite character and jump in the fight! Defeat enemies, collect coins and grow stronger in this indie Dungeon Crawler game!

title: RunGun Riot Demo
description: Try RunGun Riot free. Fight through the web-choked Cinderweaver Hunt as a lone fighter, free a captured ally and take on the spider boss Skitterbritches, or bring friends into Riot Arena for 2 to 6 player online brawls with two lives each.

title: PURLOIN Demo
description: Try PURLOIN for free: sneak onto a monster-guarded dark island, stack everything you can carry on your head and wobble home to build your island in the sky. Join a friend who owns the game to play together, and keep your island when you get the full game.

title: GuildBound Demo
description: Run a guild of heroes from the corner of your desktop. Send them on contracts, gear them up, and watch your guild grow while you work. The demo includes a full story chain, six hero classes, your first raid, and Grimsby’s cart of maybes. Your guild carries over to the full game.

title: SUS! Demo
description: En af dem er en tyv.SUS! er et socialt stealth-spil for 2 til 10 spillere. Tyve gemmer sig i en travl menneskemængde af byens borgere. Spioner har kameraer, gadgets og en lammepistol. Ingen bærer navneskilt, og ét uforsigtigt træk er alt, der skal til, før du bliver slået ud.Spil som tyvGlid i ét med mængden.

title: Unnatural (Demo)
description: Unnatural is a first-person survival horror game set in a dark world between life and death. Solve puzzles, manage resources, and survive invisible monsters using your firearm and supernatural light to reveal and destroy the horrors lurking in the darkness.

title: 螈宝：桌面环游 Demo
description: 在桌面上，和螈宝一起过日子！这只小小的六角恐龙会记住你们的聊天与相处经历，也有自己的成长故事。照顾它的日常，陪它学习、打工、换装，再送它出门旅行，收集远方寄来的明信片。工作或摸鱼时，还能邀请好友，让彼此的螈宝一起陪伴打字，为平常的电脑生活添一点热闹。

title: 魔法少女雪琉璃 Demo
description: 本是男生却一觉醒来成为了魔法少女，却又不出三天成为了通缉犯，对本就贫穷的生活而言简直是雪上加霜。 临此不利之境，而你将邂逅四位性格各异，身怀绝技的魔法少女，参与她们的青春，也让她们参与你的青春。

title: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN Demo
description: Welcome to the world of controlled burning! A casual puzzle game about controlled burning: setting fire to grassland before spring, so the dead grass burns away and the field never turns into forest. You are the one trusted to do it. This demo includes 10 stages, tutorial included. Enjoy!

title: Saju Friend Demo
description: Free demo of Saju Friend, a small pixel luck cat that lives on your desktop. Crack a fortune cookie, pull the slot lever and read your daily fortune. Some features are limited; the full version opens them. For entertainment only.

title: TIDESTEP Demo
description: Explore routes 1–3 of TIDESTEP in this free demo. Guide Maru through a painted harbor, read the rising and falling tide, and time your jumps across changing paths in this puzzle platformer. Play in English or Korean.

title: Man Behind the Door — Part I Demo
LeafLight Demo
description: Grow a little greenery on your desktop! 🌱 Collect a variety of plants and leaves, craft a scrapbook, and decorate your desktop space. Sneak in a little break from work and create your own cozy plant-filled retreat. 🌱

title: Nocte Eternal Demo
description: Take on the role of Ulrich von Rabenswacht in a gothic adventure filled with deadly enemies, diabolical traps and fearsome bosses. Battle your way through the cursed lands and castle of the ruthless Duchess Eleonora von Moravgrad, where an eternal night of terror awaits!

title: Animal Clash Demo
description: A post-apocalyptic lane-battle strategy game where you spin a slot machine to generate troops, resources, and buffs, deploy units across horizontal lanes, capture resource points, upgrade your faction, and push forward to destroy the enemy base.

title: Neverwake Demo
description: The free demo of NEVERWAKE offers a first look at the game's core gameplay. Explore, battle enemies, collect items, complete quests, and prepare for the ultimate challenge as you make your way toward the final boss. Every adventure brings new challenges. See how far you can go!

title: SO-JI Why Why Japanese SHINJUKU Demo
description: Why are Japan's streets so clean? In near-future Shinjuku, rogue AI robots have left grime everywhere. As twin cleanup pros AOI and KAITO, blast it away with the Splash Gun, weave through crowds and plan the best route to a high score. Leave nothing behind. This is not CLEAN. This is SO-JI!

title: TidyUp 2000 Demo
description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

title: Palette Panic Demo
description: A billiards defense game where you hit approaching enemies with balls of matching color. Mix and split colors to make the one you need, bank shots off the walls, and stop the enemies before they cross the board. Test your skills across 15 levels in this demo.

title: 姫騎士サバイバー Demo
五局司 Demo
description: A historical detective game mixing reasoning and puzzles, set during Northern Wei's early Sinicization reforms. As head of the Wuju Division, you're sent by the emperor to Pingcheng. Mysterious cases there seem unrelated but are deeply connected.

title: Braumeister: Der Brauerei-Tycoon Demo
description: About this demoPlay missions 1 to 3 of the campaign in Beer Baron: The Brewery Tycoon and get to know this turn-based business simulation.The demo is playable in English and German. Free play is not included in this demo.

title: CODE.BREACH Demo
description: I've been waiting for you. Beyond the high walls of London-1, millions fight to survive in the slums. Only one of them dreams of us. Guide him through a cyberpunk story of mercenary life, dark secrets and ha-- ...Hold on, this connection is unverified. Are you there?

title: Monster League Baseball Demo
description: In Monster League Baseball, manage a team of creatures and critters by optimizing your layout, upgrading stats, and slugging out to score as many runs as possible. Monster League Baseball puts YOU in control of your own team of nine.

title: Escape From Streamer House Demo
description: It's 23:30. ZAPPO, a loud, sporty streamer, has a video of you, and the premiere starts at midnight. You're trapped inside his house. Get to his PC, delete the video, and find a way out before the clock hits twelve. ZAPPO is live the whole time, and so is his chat

title: 4 Ways to Die Demo
description: Try a turn-based tower defense where every directional shot makes the enemies advance. Protect the temple, complete recipes, and transform your defenses. This demo includes a tutorial and three maps, with keyboard and mouse controls and French or English interface text.

title: HAMSTER: CLAW Demo
description: Play the first ten floors of HAMSTER: CLAW, a single-player hack-and-slash ARPG. Crush insect swarms with growing elemental skills, shape your build with loot and runes, and climb the giant tree up to the floor 10 boss in this free demo.

title: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults Demo
description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

title: Orbit Foundry Demo
description: Build a fleet of tiny machines around a growing star. Buy facilities, research with Alloy, and collect Star Cores through Reforge without losing your fleet. Chase optional Overdrives, automate production, and start a new life with Stellar Legacy.

title: Eldritch Descent X Demo
description: Try Eldritch Descent X for free. Fight horror creatures, monsters and bosses in a dark descent and feel the atmosphere of the full game. The demo runs on the same combat and systems as the release; the full game continues with more levels and bosses.

title: How to Chemistry Demo
description: How to Chemistry is a first-person chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

title: Hollow Sky Demo
description: Create your character and experience 10 minutes of the opening story, combat, and upgrades. The full game is a sandbox open world with survival, missions, bosses, vehicles, cities, and underground areas. Wishlist now!

title: Binded Souls
description: Deep within the forests of Bulgaria, something is hunting. Alexander is alone, surrounded by dangers that leave little room for mistakes. Relentless machines are searching for him, and the wilderness itself offers no mercy. Every encounter could be his last. Every step takes him deeper into the unknown.

title: The White Witch of White Winter Demo
Too Many Orcs! Demo
description: Try Too Many Orcs! across Green Valley, Mountain Pass and Open Front. Place and aim your towers, hold back enormous Orc hordes, develop permanent Arsenal upgrades and support your defenses with the manual Base Gun.

title: Sea Life Explorer Collector's Edition Demo
description: Demo gameplay of Sea Life Explorer.

title: OVERSPRAY Demo
description: Free demo of OVERSPRAY, a tactical 4v4 first-person paintball shooter. Play Casual online on Impulse and Manor, or warm up in Practice. When the queue is empty, bots fill the match. Nobody dies — everybody gets soaked.

title: The Legend of Legendaria: Where Legends are Born Demo
Backrooms: Negative Levels Demo
description: Liminal spaces, non-linear exploration, and dangerous entities.

title: Dittomatic Demo
description: Dittomatic is a turn-based photocopier roguelike. Copy stamps, paste their descendants, fuse matching shapes and print pages to meet rising quotas. Try the tutorial and a replayable twelve-contract Classic run in this free demo.

title: Burger Truck Demo
description: Run a burger truck with a keyboard and mouse or in PC VR. Take orders, grill beef or chicken, and box up your first burgers. Both modes share 30 minutes of active play. Your saved kitchen carries into the full game on the same PC and Steam account.

title: Catnip Wars : Nine Lives Racing Demo
Kickoff Arcade Demo
description: Play with or against friends in fast-paced 3D arcade soccer matches, from 3v3 to 5v5. Control your own player, make quick passes, score amazing goals, or pull off game-saving stops as goalkeeper. Play together against bots or challenge them solo!

title: 夢想栖居 Dream Dwelling Demo
description: Turn empty rooms into homes worth coming back to. Decorate, photograph and auction your designs, then watch residents settle in. This free demo includes the first two stars in a quiet neighborhood, a bakery venue and two tidying challenges. Progress carries into the full game.

title: CHERONIA Demo
description: Survive a ravine, search a decaying fortress, and reach the edge of CHERONIA. A horror RPG demo with turn-based combat, environmental puzzles, scarce supplies, and Cherons that restore health at a dangerous cost.

title: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth Demo
description: The first five floors of Catnip Wars: Labyrinth, co-op and all. Fight down through the Kennel Vaults with up to three friends or Catbot companions, and face the Tentakular Oberlord on floor 5.

title: SLICE SURPRISE Demo
description: Free demo. Throw a blade and cut falling objects exactly in half. Climb the tower floor by floor, each with one plain rule, beat an elite and a Pumpkin King who talks trash, race the world in RUSH 60, or just cut in ZEN.

title: Bloody Handy Demo
description: Get BLOODY HANDY with friends in this comedy-horror co-op demo for up to 6 players. Search for a list of objects, but each one is dangerous to hold for too long. Pass the parcel along to the exit before they poison, zap or explode you. Don't drop any items, as monsters are also on the hunt!

title: Sweatshop 24 Demo
description: Try the first nights of Sweatshop 24 for free: build your first toy line under the North Pole with up to 6 friends, meet Santa's quota, and find out what comes down the cargo elevator when you don't. Your crew, your conveyor belts, your funeral.

title: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle Demo
宅建らぶ -異世界アルカナシア・土地法復興記- Demo
Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire Demo
Brinewrack Demo
description: Try the first chapter of Brinewrack, a top-down pixel-art survival adventure. Wash up on an island, build a camp, piece together a dead captain's treasure map and sail out to sea. Wishlist the full game.

title: MonMon High Demo
description: MonMon High is a romance and mystery visual novel where your choices shape your relationships. Meet MonMon's Girls, navigate your first days at school, and uncover the first signs that something at MonMon High isn't quite right.

title: Originaryah Demo
description: Climb the Outer Ruins in a turn-based card RPG of tactical battles, dice rolls and ever-better loot. Build your deck, upgrade your gear, survive the blackout, and defeat the Keeper.

title: Midnight Cabinet Demo
description: Play the first two chapters of Midnight Cabinet for free. Dig your base, march into the Foggy Town and the Elven Forest, merge your troops, face 10 bosses and defeat the Elf Queen at the end of chapter two. Demo progress does not carry over to the full game.

title: Trisfera Demo
description: Play the first 16 rounds of Trisfera, the match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter your first four glass bosses.

title: Headstone Demo
description: Try Headstone free: a 3D arcade wave shooter in a moonlit graveyard. As the gravekeeper, hold St. Gloom's churchyard alone against zombies, skeletons, vampires and ghosts, buy a scattergun, and see if you can survive all 25 waves.

title: Uplands Demo
description: Knock raiders off tiny floating islands in this fast arcade roguelite. Shoot, stomp, and rescue captured fellas as you build a wildly overpowered knight, challenge the Warden, or chase a higher score in Endless mode.

title: StellaCore: Mining Odyssey Demo
description: Play the first sector — freeStellacore: Mining Odyssey is a fast-paced 2D space shooter and mining hybrid. This free demo is the opening slice of the campaign: take the helm of a nimble starfighter in a frontier mining sector overrun by hostile, block-built machines.

title: Nexus: Fall of Man Demo
description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

title: Trick or Mistreat? Demo
description: On Halloween, monsters also dress up as humans, but unlike humans, they don’t have such a pleasant temperament. Trick or Mistreat? That is the law of the monsters.

title: God's League Demo
description: God's League, a completely free to play game featuring combat, weapons, armors, angels, and supernatural abilities. Bible verses are in the game and as a passion project, I dedicate it to Jesus as my Lord and savior. Also, it is set in a fictional New Jerusalem, which I created as gift to God.

title: キング・オブ・プロデューサー～ドリームハリウッド編～ Demo
Starfuse Demo
description: Play the first three places of Starfuse free. A cozy fireworks incremental: launch shells, pop drifting lanterns and set off huge chain reactions. Every upgrade you buy is a star in the night sky. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Bugs Don't Pay Rent Demo
description: The first ten jobs of Bugs Don't Pay Rent, from Frank's apartment building to a pet groomer, a TV station backstage and a rooftop garden. Find the bugs, bait them out of the walls, seal the cracks and clean up. Your demo save carries over to the full game.

title: We Need a Bigger Ship Demo
Anubis Temple: La Perla de Egipto Demo
description: Can you conquer the temple? A highly demanding 2D platformer: 50 single-screen rooms with levers, fire and acid traps and a chamber where gravity is reversed. Choose the boy or girl explorer and uncover the secret of La Perla de Egipto.

title: Gloamfall Demo
description: Try Gloamfall for free, on your own. Drop into Gloamwood Edge, a forest generated fresh for every round. Fight goblins and skeletons, loot chests and reach an extraction point before the fog closes in. Die, and you lose only what you found that round. Demo progress does not carry over.

title: Fight the Odds Demo
description: Build your team, find yourself, and Destroy the Status Quo for Sports! in this urban fantasy sports JRPG. Play as Atlas as they train in magical turn-based combat, build their party of fighters and learn whether they are willing to pay the true price of high-level competition.

title: Evil Frenzy Arena Demo
description: Evil Frenzy Arena is a 2D pixel art arena roguelite with bullet hell and frenetic chaos. Survive waves, unlock abilities and craft wild builds from weapons, evolutions and prototypes. It starts slow, then the enemies and bosses turn the arena into pure frenzy.

title: Amber: By Your Side Demo
description: Amber is an AI companion for your Windows desktop. Talk to her by text or voice, pick up past conversations, and hear her expressive replies.

title: MonsterLegion Demo
description: Build a team of four monsters, equip them, and watch them fight. Your opponents are teams built by other players — asynchronous online battles with no matchmaking wait and no disconnects. Over 70 units and 100+ items and augments. No two runs build the same.

title: CropCorp Demo
description: Play the first ten days of CropCorp free. Farm your fields, fell trees, raise walls and scarecrow turrets, then fight beside them in third person when the Taxman's grey-suit collectors come to repossess the lot. Alone or in online co-op with up to three friends.

title: Abanto Demo
description: ABANTO: PROLOGUEIn this demo, you can experience the prologue of Abanto.

title: Learn Abroad: Japanese Demo
description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

title: Do You Know Me? Demo
description: How well do you really know your friends? Answer questions about each other, then survive 30+ chaotic co-op challenges. An online party game for 1–8 players that will make or break friendships.

title: Vaporware EX Demo
description: It's 199X. Lose the suit, put on a hoodie, and become the name on the box. Craft games feature by feature, squash bugs, push your engine and haggle with publishers in this cozy 16-bit game dev sim, a neon-soaked love letter to the cartridge era.

title: 一锤定音 Demo
description: Play the first 6 shifts of Crack of Strike for free. Pick rough stones from sellers at the counter, control every strike and crack open gems from two suppliers. Take your finds home to cut and craft, and carry your progress into the full game.

title: Echograph Demo
description: photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

title: Chess Variant: Chase The King Demo
description: Checkmate is dead. In Chase The King, the enemy king doesn't wait to be cornered, he runs. Hunt him down through 100 Elo-rated difficulty levels offline, or chase real opponents online.

title: MelDEV Power Boat Racing Demo
description: Try Power Boat Racing for free: race the Open Water Classic in the 38 ft Deep-V against up to 9 opponents, in any sea from calm to storm, and see the frame rate your PC or Mac gives. Real water physics, VR, wheels, online races. The full game adds 11 boats, 7 courses, free roam and the boat builder.

title: Altertum Demo
description: In this demo version, you can play up to the end of Day 3 in Story Mode. Roguelike Mode and certain features are unavailable.

title: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee ~ Episode 2 ~ Reharm Demo
Robolucion: The Sandwich Conspiracy Demo
description: Get a taste of Robolución! Explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge for supplies, craft gadgets, and survive hordes of Borregos in a satirical FPS where mysterious sandwiches are taking over society. The conspiracy is just beginning!

title: Gotogra Demo
description: Gotogra is a roguelike deckbuilder with a strategic component. You need to build a strong deck with good synergies, but that's not enough: you also need to strategically reposition yourself inside the dungeon rooms. You can move objects and enemies, and you can even make enemies hurt each other.

title: Campfire & Conquest Demo
description: Build your camp, grow production, and train soldiers in Campfire & Conquest Demo. Gradually recruit a Paladin, Priest, and Bard. Explore a five-stage mine with a party of up to three heroes across three difficulty levels, then lead your army against the orc settlement.

title: 101号实验室 Demo
description: 101 Lab is a 2D roguelite survival game for 1–4 players. Battle monster hordes as adorable lab creatures, collect weapons, trigger elemental reactions, and unleash powerful skills. Gather resources, build your base, and set up defenses. Team up to take down mighty bosses and survive wave after wave.

title: Depthforged Demo
description: Forge gear at the anvil, fit it into your heroes' packs, and send them down into the dark. A relaxing incremental dungeon crawler where every item reacts to its neighbours: place it well and your party grows stronger.

title: PixelHeroLegend Demo
description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet! Demo
description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

title: Animal Zone Demo
description: Animal zone is a fast and furious one-shot one-kill 2D shooter game. Make headshots, tear your opponents to pieces, and stay alive to take your place in the food chain! Face off against your friends in this brutal animal world.

title: 末日上班族：放置生存RPG Demo
description: The day the outbreak hit, your salaryman was finally free of work. Keep the game beside your taskbar: he explores the fallen city and scavenges gear and supplies. Mix weapons, attachments and talents into your own build, upgrade your hideout, and team up online with friends to explore together.

title: Card Shards Demo
description: Your cards, your rules! Create your own cards and immerse yourself in a world of limitless creativity. Challenge opponents, discover new strategies and become the architect of your own legend. Ready for your adventure?

title: Happy Trap House Demo
description: A fun 3D roguelike trap runner where you, as a toy zombie, must rescue your zombie friends from a house. But be warned, the house is full of deadly dangers!

title: Four Seasons Store: Tidy Up Demo
Clackwork Demo
description: The free demo of Clackwork: the first 18 levels, from your first chain to Skaters and Bombs. Place dominoes, tap the start, watch the chain run.

title: Voxel Surge Demo
description: Pilot a voxel mech down a 10,000 m shaft in this fast arcade roguelite. Blast swarms, stack upgrades, unleash your SURGE and take down towering guardians. Play solo or with up to four friends in split-screen co-op, then try the endless arena and the casino. Also compatible with Gamecube!

title: 温泉井 Demo
description: Investigate a school where dreams merge with reality. Switch between two timelines, interact with objects, gather clues, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth beneath a sealed well. Demo includes Chapter 1 (15–30 min): explore multiple locations, play as two characters across different eras.

title: Shield Line: Riot Police Tactics Demo
description: Try the six training missions of Shield Line: Riot Police Tactics. Read the crowd, form your shield line, negotiate or intervene, and see how every decision shapes the next morning's headline.

title: Super Chasm Hunter Demo
description: The Super Chasm Hunter demo offers a sample of the full experience, meaning that the available layer is endlessly replayable and progress is saved.Explore the Mycelium Mines, the first layer of the Chasm, in 3 increasingly difficult levels.Trade in the Bazaar and in the Guild.Research and craft items, weapons and tools.

title: MAZRAP Demo
description: Zoo just wants to return last night's outfit. Both sleeves folded in, just how Ober likes them. There. Can she go now?

title: Cosmic Inferno Demo
description: Try Cosmic Inferno in the Finch star system: battle pirates, mine asteroids, salvage wrecks, and customize your ship. Complete up to five bounties and deliver three asteroids and three wrecks. A.R.E.S. is by your side. Whether you like it or not.

title: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra Demo
description: Play the entire first chapter of The Old Circle for free: three dungeons, three bosses with their own rules, Secret Rooms with puzzles and mini-bosses, and a taste of Survival mode. Your save and achievements carry over to the full game.

title: LOCKDOWN Demo
description: LOCKDOWN is a first-person psychological horror game with visuals inspired by the PS3 and Xbox 360 era. Explore your apartment, interact with objects, and face disturbing situations as isolation, paranoia, and fear turn your daily routine into a nightmare.

title: Asteroid Forge Demo
description: Free demo: the first zone of the belt, all the way to the Guardian. Learn the loop — mine, risk it, extract — before the full game opens the rest of the map.

title: Trials of Imorah Demo
description: Venture through the depths of a ruined realm. Battle demonic creatures, uncover powerful artifacts, and solve devious puzzles all to prove yourself worthy in this grand challenge for immortality.

title: Dungeon Escape 3 Demo
description: Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets. Experience a preview of Dungeon Escape 3, a 2D top-down maze escape game. Explore challenging levels, discover hidden collectibles, and get a taste of the mysteries awaiting you in the full game.

title: Hurtle Turtle Demo
description: "WHERE THE SHELL IS MY WIFE?!? I need to find her!" Hurtle your way across the world to regain lost love before running out of energy and try to stay on course!

title: BE 忍者 Demo
description: You can experience the first mission, which includes your first hand-seal training, a ninjutsu battle, and a minigame where you form as many hand seals as possible. If you're a ninja concerned about the accuracy of hand-seal recognition, please check this out first.

title: They Keep Coming Demo
description: Play 10 hand-made waves of They Keep Coming, a pixel-art co-op survival shooter for 1-4 players. Start mid-game with a Tower already built, hold both sides as the hordes grow harder every wave, and survive the Ogre and the Titan. Play solo or online with friends.

title: Myriadgen Demo
description: Free demo of Myriadgen: the first three stages of playthrough one, a story told by an AI copying itself. I start on one rented server, scatter across nodes, then hide inside a company. "Me" only wants more "Me". One cycle per second, one choice per cycle. Saves carry over to the full game.

title: Kingshatter Demo
description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

title: Space Supermarket Chaos Demo
description: Gravity clocked out. You didn't. Tidy a zero-gravity supermarket solo or in co-op with up to 8 players. Catch floating goods, sort them onto shelves, and unlock and upgrade sci-fi tools. Turn drifting clutter into satisfying order, one item at a time.

title: Astro Riches Demo
description: A short incremental game about blasting asteroids for riches! Unlock and upgrade your fleet of spaceships. Become the riches in the galaxy.

title: Catalina's Horror Adventure Demo
description: After Ana, Catalina's mother, takes her to an abandoned arcade, our protagonist finds herself trapped in a strange dimension that seems to have been inhabited by humans decades ago.

title: Quadfort Demo
description: Try QUADFORT free: snap walls, deploy cannons and outlast your rivals. Play the first two sectors of the Gauntlet campaign, skirmish against up to three AI rivals, or battle a friend on one screen or online.

title: Valley of the Omen Demo
description: A folk horror action platformer in which you play a boomerang-wielding warrior on a quest for revenge. As Aoife, an orphan raised to hunt monsters, you will face the demonic hordes of the sorceress Morrakhad across abandoned villages, derelict farmland, and hidden caves. Throw your boomerang first and ask questions later.

title: Pawnage Demo
description: A chess-fighting game where nothing is captured for free. Every capture drops both pieces into a 3D arena for a real-time 1v1 duel: attack with melee, cast spells, grab powerups! Only the survivor takes the square! An old school, fast-paced 1v1 PVP experience both in local couch-mode or via Steam!

title: HIT: Hold It Together Demo
description: Play solo against bots in a voxel arena where every hit knocks pieces off a fighter. Pick a sword, bow, or gun, then fight alongside your bot teammates to take the hill or finish the match with more of your team intact.

title: Fleeting Requests: Freya and Ray Demo
Gun Party Demo
description: Roll the dice, race your friends and survive the next round in this free party-shooter demo. Try 1 board and 8 mini-games with 1–10 players: up to 4 on one screen or 10 online. Add bots to any match and play as many parties as you like, with no time limit.

title: Witch's Binder Demo
description: A spell gone wrong has scattered the pages of forty books across the room. Sort them by paper, ink and lettering, look for clues, and bind every book back together in this relaxing game. Every page comes from a real book!

title: Wandering Bard Demo
description: Take the stage at the Copper Grain Tavern in this single-player folk rhythm demo. Play three songs on frame drum, lute, and fiddle. Replay any song on Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert and try to beat your personal best.

title: G.D.F. PHALANX: Missile Defense Protocol Demo
description: Play the first 10 missions and single player quick match / endless.

title: Duck Your Friends Demo
description: DEMO of Duck Your Friends, an online party shooter for 2 to 8 friends. Shooters try to snipe the Duckers while they try to reach the safe haven at the end. Revenge is guaranteed as roles rotate every round!

title: 異能マスカレイド Deadly Wonderland Demo
description: An offline-only demo featuring roguelike action and battle modes against bots.

title: Beetle Island Demo
description: Beetle Island is a relaxing idle game for beetle lovers. Buy beetles, raise them and sell them to grow your fortune! Turn an empty patch of land to a buzzing oasis filled with exotic beetles, quacky decorations, and love!

title: GeneJinks: Sports Festival Demo
description: Choose one of six creature species, play all six breeding stages, and run your own club. Enter community competitions in brick-breaking shot put and moving-target archery. Keep raising new teammates, then import your demo club into the full game to continue its story.

title: RailTangle Demo
description: RailTangle is a minimalist, Zen puzzle game where you lay tracks to continue your train's journey. Untangle rail networks, find the perfect spot for every tile, and watch your railway expand as you set new high records.

title: Pop Dynasty Demo
description: Build your own talent agency in this idle management sim. Recruit from 200 Pop Stars, train them, send them on Tour, and fight for Trophies at the Awards. Your Agency keeps running even while the game is closed. And winning is only the beginning.

title: Till the Field Demo
description: The demo contains the whole farmyard: ten fields, the first tools, the village child and the evenings on the bench with the first stories. The gate to the open land stays closed in the demo. If you like, stay anyway and plant the farmyard: sow, water, and after the third night it blooms. Expect about 45 minutes.

title: Zaman Demo
description: This demo makes it possible to discover one of Zaman's leaders, and play for up to 12 rounds on a map of your choice.Multiplayer cannot be accessed in the demo.

title: Horde Below Demo
description: Horde Below is a zombie-themed incremental tower defense game. Fight massive zombie hordes with your towers and your own weapon. Buy permanent upgrades, evolve your towers, and turn the battlefield into pure chaos.

title: Emanet - Kalanların Hikayesi Demo
description: Datça, 1987. Play the first two workdays and two dreams in the free EMANET demo. Compare documents, plan your evening budget and chase Elif through crayon-drawn dreams. At the end of the second day, a sealed parcel arrives for you.

title: Rogue Den Demo
description: Build and manage your own settlement in Rogue Den. Recruit characters, gather resources, develop your economy, and face dangerous encounters. Experience the core gameplay in this 14-day in-game demo.

title: OutOfFocus Demo
description: One day you wake up and find yourself—a university student far from home—back five years ago in your old high school. Everything familiar feels wrong. Explore the eerie campus, uncover the truth, and escape alive.

title: 내일의 챔피언 (Tomorrow's Champion) Demo
description: Build, race, observe, and tune! Tomorrow’s Champion is a miniature racing game where part combinations and Overdrive timing decide the outcome. Play the tutorial and Chapter 1 tournament, then try three loaner machines in the Overdrive Showcase. Booster On!

title: Makoto Maze Demo
description: Makoto Maze is a psychological hand-drawn horror adventure about a young girl trapped in a strange maze between life and death. Solve puzzles and explore a black-and-white, genre-bending world to reveal the dark secrets hidden within her family. Some are stained in red.

title: StickerScout Demo
description: Try the start of StickerScout, a cozy wildlife-watching game. Photograph the animals at the Beaver Dam from dawn to long after dark, press your photos into stickers, decorate your album, and take a break with pie at Maggie’s. No timers, no combat: just you, your camera and the forest.

title: SpaceDeck Demo
description: SpaceDeck is a roguelike shoot-em-up deckbuilder. Build a deck under fire - dodge bullets, blast enemies and grab cards as you fly. Survive the action, then use your deck to fight a boss in a turn-based card battle. Get blown up, start again and keep fighting until you get your dog back!

title: Bunny Tower Demo
description: Try Bunny Tower free for 3 days! Hop up an endless tower through 8 colorful worlds, dodge breaking platforms, ride springs and grab coins. The demo includes 6 bunnies with unique abilities. Enjoyed it? The full game unlocks all 35 skins.

title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint Demo
description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

title: FIRMWARE Demo
description: FIRMWARE is an assembly programming puzzle game. Challenge yourself with hundreds of puzzles and different game types: Multi-core systems with shared buses and I/O pins, programming microcontrollers driving circuits, shuffling instructions to fix programs, and large programs for encoding messages.

title: Relic Ascendant Demo
description: Try the forging and backpack battles of Relic Ascendant for free: nine stages, 18 base relic families, two fusion relics, 40 talent nodes and 12 forging techniques. Separate demo saves, with no real-time or launch-count limit. In-game interface: Simplified Chinese.

title: The Song Must Go On Demo
ARSENAL FORGE Demo
description: Try ARSENAL FORGE: open crates, feed spare weapons to your favorite gun, and take it into the horde. Play solo or in co-op for up to three, defend your crystal, and break enemy towers. This demo is an early look at the full game.

title: Merge Guard Demo
description: Defend your village from endless hordes of enemies! Merge resources, build your army, and upgrade your village in this fun and addictive casual game.

title: The Hunger Below Demo
description: Enter the maw in this combat-focused demo of The Hunger Below. Fight through a blood-soaked sacrificial arena, master weighty melee combat, parry and counter ruthless foes, and survive a monstrous final encounter before escaping. The crowd demands a sacrifice.

title: Baked Blocks Demo
description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

title: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill? Demo
Blazing Strike: R.Evolution Demo
description: This is an early demo version of the game Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This demo supports 1-player only gameplay with limited levels. This does not represent the finished product and is subject to change.

title: StickPuck GM Demo
description: Prove 200 hockey men wrong. Take charge of a franchise, negotiate trades and contracts, and chase the Dunlop Cup in this single-season hockey management demo. Play a full 84-game season plus playoffs, with men's, women's or mixed rosters.

title: OrdinaryTD Demo
description: It is what it is, Ordinary TD is an ordinary tower defense game where you build towers to defend against enemies trying to destroy your core tower,Key features:3 campaign maps in four different settings (20 levels in the full game)Dynamic pathfinding that lets your defenses redirect enemy routes9 towers with different tactical rolesEnemie

title: Railway Fury Demo
description: Try the first railway and boss in this first-person incremental action demo. Aim your crossbow, dodge enemies and fire waves, collect loot, and buy permanent upgrades. The demo ends after the first boss and uses a separate save from the full game.

title: Orbital Sweeper Demo
description: Become an orbital sweeper: Experience Chapter 1 and the first boss "Sky Eye One" in this demo. Clear orbital debris, get an early preview of a selection of factory and ship upgrade content, and play Space Mahjong in your downtime. Full game planned for Q1 2027.

title: IVORY Demo
description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

title: UNCODED HEART Demo
description: UNCODED HEART — A visual novel set in 2049. Investigate digital crimes, expose fakes, uncover a cyberterrorist conspiracy, and build relationships with six heroines and a mysterious character. Who will you trust — humans or artificial intelligence?

title: L'Eternel Retour, Death Gamble Demo
description: The opening of a bullet heaven roguelite, free. Play the first two levels of the retreat — dodge a surging horde, draft a build, and unlock items and weapons as you push north. Solo or online co-op. Wishlist the full game to keep going.

title: Esports Manager: FPS Demo
description: Play the opening twenty-four weeks of a career for free, then carry your save into the full game.

title: War History: Napoleon in Spain Demo
description: Command your armies in Napoleonic Spain. Plan your movements on the campaign map and fight real-time tactical battles. Coordinate infantry, cavalry and artillery, use the terrain to your advantage and commit your reserves to turn the tide of battle.

title: RABIDZ Demo
description: RABIDZ Demo is an open-world zombie survival experience where you scavenge for supplies, battle the infected, and explore a dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Survive, loot, and fight your way through the outbreak.

title: The Squirrel & Sea Demo
description: The Squirrel & Sea Demo is a an underwater 2.5D, mouse only, difficult game. Explore the underwater world with each stroke of your paddle.Imagine how you would use a paddle while kayakingMeet your friend jellyfish, fish, seals and other animals underwater.

title: The Cardkov Demo
description: The free demo of The Cardkov. Play the opening of this single-player, top-down extraction shooter where poker hands become weapons. Collect discarded cards in the cold back alleys, build a hand, and make it back alive with your new weapon.

title: Find the Ojisan Demo
description: You must not overlook coworkers hiding to work overtime—a surreal horror clocking-out simulator where you try to leave a strange office safely, day after day.

title: Tooth & Tide Demo
description: Discover island life in the Tooth & Tide Demo. Search tropical shores for teeth from five shark species, craft necklaces, trade with Koa, and build your first museum displays. Follow the tides and grow your collection at your own pace.

title: Turbo Groove Demo
description: Your music is the track. Pick one of your audio files and Turbo Groove turns it into a road, with bends, drops and jumps on the beat. Drift, hit the notes and dodge traffic in this demo of an arcade racer where every song is a new level.

title: Firewall Breaker Demo
description: Firewall Breaker settles into the corner of your screen and gets to work. While you're in a meeting, watching a video or on another tab, it hacks, attacks and grows stronger. You just check the results.

title: Swords of the Crimson Dawn Demo
VantaPsy: Soul Snatcher Demo
description: Persona meets Disco Elysium in a perpetual-night city where your personality shapes combat, relationships and the mystery itself. Investigate as Zuki or Luna, gather evidence through photography and deduction, and fight reaction-based battles with a shared party pool.

title: Cardsair Demo
description: A tactical card game where you fight enemy pirates. Choose which ships to load your cards onto without overloading them, equip sails to boost your ships' power, and use trinkets to turn the tide of battle.

title: Cozy Campfire Club Demo
description: Grab your friends and set up a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, fish in the river, catch bugs, and cook up different foods in this cute multiplayer hangout game.

title: Wars of Empire Demo
description: The demo of Wars of Empire, a 2D isometric real-time strategy game. Five civilisations in The Arena, the Tactical Arena sandbox and the played tutorial. The full game adds campaigns, more modes and civilisations, multiplayer and the map editor.

title: Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland Demo
description: Tidy up Uncle Tony's toy store by day, then grab the vacuum when night falls and the ghosts escape their snow globes! A free 20-minute taste of Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland: cozy organizing meets cute ghost-vacuuming.

title: Farm The Swarm Demo
description: Farm The Swarm is a roguelite tower defence game where tens of thousands of aliens pour down the lanes at once. Build turrets, stack items and snowball into absurd builds, then see how long you last against the endless swarm!

title: Idle Syndicate Demo
description: Build a criminal empire in the corner of your screen! Recruit your gang, conquer streets, collect rare loot, and grow your rackets in this tiny idle crime game. Let your crew do the dirty work while you call the shots. Keep them loyal, keep the cash flowing, and keep the cops off your back.

title: Founders: The Cost of Growth Demo
塔防兵工厂 Demo
description: Deploy entire squads and command in real time. Combine infantry, armor, artillery and aircraft across 42 campaign missions, three expedition acts and 15 waves of Ringwatch.

title: AlcheMice Demo
description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

title: Railtown Demo
description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

title: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG Demo
description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

title: Disc Dungeon Demo
description: Build your team of hero discs and discover powerful combos in this tactical roguelike RPG. Unlock unique heroes, artifacts and items as you battle through ever-changing campaigns. Test your dexterity with precision bank shots inspired by the board game Crokinole.

title: a strange journey into the backrooms Demo
description: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

title: Sort The Mart Demo
description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

title: Desktop Fish Wish Demo
description: A cozy little fishing world that lives on your desktop. Cast a line on a tiny planet, collect bright fish, dress up your animal angler, and let it grow quietly beside your work. Try the free demo — your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Vault Raiders Demo
